differences_found_and_fixed.symptom: The public room rendered blue/purple instead of green/brown.
differences_found_and_fixed.cause: SwfBitmap.toBitmapData wrote Flash ARGB bytes into an OpenFL ByteArray whose HTML5 default is host little-endian.
differences_found_and_fixed.fix: Set ByteArray.endian to BIG_ENDIAN before BitmapData.setPixels.
differences_found_and_fixed.regression: G2 now asserts the known netcafe RGBA sample survives BitmapData upload; integrated G2 passes 927 assertions and 118 comparisons.

differences_found_and_fixed.symptom: The opaque black 720x490 room bitmap rectangle was visible against a dark-grey stage.
differences_found_and_fixed.cause: The production OpenFL project retained the prototype #10131A stage background while the AIR client uses black.
differences_found_and_fixed.fix: Set the production project window background to #000000.
